title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science Paper 1 (Computer Systems)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science 0478 Paper 1 (Computer Systems): five compulsory 15-mark structured questions on topics 1-6, 1 hour 45 minutes, 75 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** the questions. You have 1 hour 45 minutes. Calculators are not allowed.

- Each question is worth 15 marks.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 of the 2026-2028 syllabus; the real paper's questions vary in length. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science Paper 2 (Algorithms, Programming and Logic)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science 0478 Paper 2 (Algorithms, Programming and Logic): five 12-mark structured questions on topics 7-10 and a 15-mark scenario question, 1 hour 45 minutes, 75 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** the questions. You have 1 hour 45 minutes. Calculators are not allowed.

- Write algorithms in pseudocode (or Python, Visual Basic or Java for the scenario question).
- The final scenario question is worth 15 marks: plan your solution before you write it.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 of the 2026-2028 syllabus; the real paper's questions vary in length. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
